C45.name: C45 · hypothetical CAPEX grant 45%; biomethane value proxy €1.87/Nm³

C0.name: C0 · no CAPEX grant; biomethane value proxy €1.87/Nm³

grant_awarding_organization: User-defined hypothetical scenario; RVO eligibility and award not verified

financial_basis.performance_improvements: None: original modeled sales and OPEX; no assumed cost reductions or revenue/yield uplifts.
financial_basis.capex_basis: high direct uninstalled equipment CAPEX from current cost register; digester tank at €1,800/m3
financial_basis.operating_premium_basis: Dynamic per-candidate biomethane output (annual biomethane kg divided by the traceable 0.71751 kg/Nm3 pure-methane reference density at 0 degC and 101.325 kPa) multiplied by the average user-specified value of €1.87/Nm3; nominal support applied for the configured project lifetime. This is a scenario proxy, not an official SDE++ award calculation; sensitivity range €1.28–€2.46/Nm3 is retained for later analysis.
financial_basis.npv_basis: After-tax constant-account screening NPV using Configure defaults; no financing, escalation, replacement, working capital, residual value or installed-CAPEX factor unless explicitly entered.

carbon_basis.boundary: operational process inventory plus upstream life-cycle utility supply-chain emissions
carbon_basis.net_carbon_definition: Modeled inventory climate load × 12/44 minus retained product carbon, t C/year.
carbon_basis.fiber_fate: 100% of modeled press-cake carbon assumed in furniture over 20 years; manufacturing loss and end-of-life excluded.
carbon_basis.soil_fate: 10% of modeled nutrient-rich-solids carbon retained in soil as an explicit screening assumption.
carbon_basis.protein_carbon_credit: none; protein may be fed or used as biostimulant and no split/retention rate is specified.
excluded: downstream product use except stated product-carbon stock

biomethane_support_conversion.calculation: reported biomethane product kg/year ÷ traceable pure-methane reference density × value per Nm3; candidate-specific mass is used, with no feed-yield proxy

density_source.basis: Pure methane real-gas density at 273.15 K and 101.325 kPa (JIS/STP). Used to convert modeled biomethane mass to normal volume for the €/Nm3 support overlay.
density_source.source_title: LNG Measurement: A User's Guide to Custody Transfer — Fluid Properties
density_source.source_table_page: Section 1.2, pp. 1.2-3–1.2-4, Eq. (2)–(3); reported density and uncertainty
density_source.applicability: Pure methane reference density; actual biomethane composition, purity, and calorific value may differ. The volume conversion is a screening normalization, not a product-quality measurement.
density_source.uncertainty: NIST report gives ±0.00006 kg/m3 for the pure-methane reference density; this does not include product-composition or model uncertainty.

biomethane_support_conversion.standard_conditions: Nm3 at 0 degC and 101.325 kPa; biomethane treated as methane for mass-volume conversion
biomethane_support_conversion.caveat: Screening overlay only; actual SDE++ support depends on eligible biomethane injection and annual correction amounts.

grass_utilization_bonus.label: Grass utilization/logistics bonus
grass_utilization_bonus.status: User-defined hypothetical support; not an awarded subsidy
grass_utilization_bonus.basis: Rate × annual wet tonnes actually processed; post-route economics only; no process chemistry, balances, or emissions change.

product_eligibility.rule: At least one positive annual product flow; only positive-NPV and >14,000 t/year processed rows are published.

limitations: C30/C45/C60/C0 CAPEX grant fractions and €0–50/wet t grass-use bonuses are user-defined what-if values, not awards or verified programme eligibility determinations.

The OPEX overlay multiplies each candidate's modeled biomethane volume by the average €1.87/Nm3 value; €1.28–€2.46/Nm3 is retained as a later sensitivity range. This is not a verified RVO tariff or guaranteed support.
RVO DEI+ eligibility, eligible cost base, grant ceiling and co-funding conditions are not assessed.
Hypothetical biomethane support is modeled from each candidate's output for the configured project lifetime without official annual market corrections or an eligibility test.
CAPEX is high direct uninstalled screening cost; installation and unpriced/uncosted components may be missing.
OPEX remains partial; NPV is an after-tax screening proxy using the shared Configure assumptions, not an investment-grade project forecast.

Climate inventory includes electricity, heat, and modeled process emissions; the JRC electricity factor includes upstream electricity supply, while most other upstream/downstream burdens remain excluded.
Net carbon includes assumed furniture and soil carbon retention; no manufacturing loss or end-of-life release is represented.
The fronts are bounded by the sampled configurations and are not global optima.
The 30,000 t/year project supply and all regional imports are user-directed scenarios, not measured or contracted feed; the July/October 60/40 split is an explicit assumption.
Only positive-NPV rows are published as requested. This truncates the economic distribution and is not an unbiased estimate of route viability.

feed_composition_profile.basis: wet mass fraction; mass fractions sum to 1

trial_composition.source_basis: 30,000 wet t/year user project context; higher flows are hypothetical regional imports
